summary: BingEx Ltd (Nasdaq: FLX, branded FlashEx) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing unaudited second quarter 2026 results. Revenue was RMB940.3 million (US$138.6 million) versus RMB1,024.6 million a year earlier, gross margin fell to 10.2% from 12.0%, and the company swung to a net loss of RMB34.0 million from net income of RMB53.5 million. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation, though it notes roughly 3.9 million ADSs repurchased for about US$11.8 million as of August 19, 2026.
